target_event: 2027-10-14까지 EDGAR에 Hope-Neuron Therapeutx의 Form C-AR(연차보고서)이 제출된다.
resolution_rule: SEC EDGAR의 발행사 CIK 0002114933 제출 목록에 Form C-AR 또는 C-AR/A가 있는지.
missing_evidence_treatment: 제출이 확인되지 않으면 '미발생'으로 기록하되 공모 미성사(의무 없음)와 미제출을 구분할 수 없음을 표시한다. 조회 불가 시 '미확인'으로 둔다.

target_event: 2027-10-14까지 제출되는 Form C-AR 또는 새 Form C가 보고하는 직전 회계연도 매출이 $0을 초과한다.
resolution_rule: 해당 Form C-AR 또는 Form C의 XML 필드 revenueMostRecentFiscalYear 값.
missing_evidence_treatment: 해당 보고서가 제출되지 않았거나 확인할 수 없으면 사건 실패로 세지 않고 '미확인'으로 처리한다.

target_event: By 2027-04-14, a Form C-U or Form C/A filed on EDGAR by the issuer (or its Republic deal page, if later found in a retrievable pack) reports that the offering has closed with at least the $75,000 target amount sold.
resolution_rule: EDGAR filing index for CIK 0002114933 (Form C-U, C/A, or C-AR stating the amount sold) or a Republic deal-page closing notice.
missing_evidence_treatment: If no filing or notice is found by the date, the outcome is recorded as unresolved or not-yet-disclosed, not as the event failing. A Form C-W or a stated return of funds resolves it as not occurred.

target_event: By 2027-10-14, a filing by the issuer on EDGAR (Form C-U, C-AR or a new Form C) states that an IRB or FDA approval, clearance or IND for a human SELtx trial has been obtained, or that the first human participant has been treated.
resolution_rule: Issuer Form C-U or Form C-AR on EDGAR, or an issuer-posted update, naming the approval or first-treatment event with a date.
missing_evidence_treatment: If the issuer files nothing, or files only generic progress language, the outcome is unresolved (not-disclosed) and must not be counted as the event failing. An issuer that stops reporting after the first annual report is also unresolved.

target_event: By 2027-04-15, an amended Form C (C/A) or a progress update (C-U) is filed on EDGAR for TradeFunded LLC offering 020-37393 reporting at least one closing or the amount sold.
resolution_rule: An EDGAR filing index for CIK 0002128340 showing a Form C/A or C-U filed by 2027-04-15 that states closing or sales information.
missing_evidence_treatment: If no such filing appears, the result is recorded as 'no disclosure observed'. It is not counted as the business failing to raise money, because the issuer may have closed without a public filing or may have filed late.

target_event: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx reports that its Regulation Crowdfunding offering reached the $75,000 target and had at least one closing
resolution_rule: issuer_announces: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx reports that its Regulation Crowdfunding offering reached the $75,000 target and had at least one closing | scope: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx, Inc., Reg CF offering file no. 020-37299, US, at least one closing with proceeds released to the issuer
missing_evidence_treatment: If no filing or platform report is found by the deadline plus lag, the result is unknown and not false.
permitted_evidence: Form C-U; Form C-AR; Form C/A; Republic deal page; SEC EDGAR filing by the issuer

target_event: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx receives IRB approval for a human ALS trial of SELtx
resolution_rule: independently_corroborated: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx receives IRB approval for a human ALS trial of SELtx | scope: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx, Inc., human ALS trial of SELtx, any US IRB, approval granted (not an IND, FDA clearance or dosing)
missing_evidence_treatment: Absent independent confirmation by the deadline plus lag, the result is unknown and not false.
permitted_evidence: Clinical trial registry entry; Letter or statement from the IRB or clinical site; Third-party news report

target_event: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx publicly reports the conversion of either outstanding convertible promissory note into equity
resolution_rule: issuer_announces: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx publicly reports the conversion of either outstanding convertible promissory note into equity | scope: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx, Inc., the $60,000 (2025-07-22) or $150,000 (2026-06-12) note, conversion completed; US
missing_evidence_treatment: If no report is found by the deadline plus lag, the result is unknown and not false.
permitted_evidence: Form C-U; Form C-AR; Form C/A; Issuer press release; Republic deal page

target_event: Mightylicious Inc publicly reports that investment commitments in the Series 2026 SAFE offering total at least the $75,000 Target Offering Amount
resolution_rule: issuer_announces: Mightylicious Inc publicly reports that investment commitments in the Series 2026 SAFE offering total at least the $75,000 Target Offering Amount | scope: Mightylicious Inc, Reg CF offering via OpenDeal Portal LLC dba Republic, SEC file no. 020-37424, United States; threshold: commitments of at least $75,000
missing_evidence_treatment: If no public report is found by the deadline plus the reporting lag, resolve as unknown, not false.
permitted_evidence: Form C-U or Form C/A filed on SEC EDGAR; Republic deal page (republic.com/mightylicious) status update; Issuer press release or investor email

target_event: Mightylicious Inc files a Form C-W withdrawing the Series 2026 SAFE offering
resolution_rule: issuer_announces: Mightylicious Inc files a Form C-W withdrawing the Series 2026 SAFE offering | scope: Mightylicious Inc, Reg CF offering via OpenDeal Portal LLC dba Republic, SEC file no. 020-37424, filed on SEC EDGAR
missing_evidence_treatment: If EDGAR filings cannot be checked, resolve as unknown, not false.
permitted_evidence: Form C-W on SEC EDGAR; Republic deal page status

target_event: TradeFunded LLC's Regulation CF offering reaches and closes on at least the $74,999.75 Target Offering Amount in accepted, fully paid commitments, with a first closing completed.
resolution_rule: event_occurs: TradeFunded LLC's Regulation CF offering reaches and closes on at least the $74,999.75 Target Offering Amount in accepted, fully paid commitments, with a first closing completed. | scope: TradeFunded LLC, Form C accession 0002128340-26-000005, offering file no. 020-37393, US Reg CF offering via OpenDeal Portal LLC (Republic); at least $74,999.75 closed.
missing_evidence_treatment: If no closing evidence is found by the deadline plus reporting lag, resolve as unknown rather than false; silence is not false.
permitted_evidence: Form C-U or Form C-AR filed on EDGAR reporting progress or results; Issuer or Republic Deal Page update showing a closing; Later SEC EDGAR filings by the issuer

target_event: TradeFunded LLC files a Form C-W withdrawing its Regulation CF offering.
resolution_rule: issuer_announces: TradeFunded LLC files a Form C-W withdrawing its Regulation CF offering. | scope: TradeFunded LLC, offering file no. 020-37393, filing on SEC EDGAR, United States.
missing_evidence_treatment: If no Form C-W is found, resolve as not occurred only after the deadline plus lag; absence of evidence before then stays unknown.
permitted_evidence: Form C-W filed on SEC EDGAR; Issuer or Republic Deal Page notice of withdrawal or cancellation
